summary: ProQR Therapeutics N.V., a Dutch clinical-stage RNA editing company listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K — the foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a U.S. Form 8-K — disclosing the appointment of Chris Hart, PhD, as Chief Data and AI Officer, and Thomas Wolf, PhD, to the Board of Directors as strategic AI advisor, effective September 23, 2026, per the attached press release. The appointments are framed as supporting ProQR's AI strategy across its Axiomer platform and pipeline, including AX-0811. No compensation, share issuance, or transaction terms were stated, and no advisor was named. Watch for any Form 6-K disclosing equity inducement grants or board committee assignments.
